# hatchet_user_group (Resource)

Manages an organization user group. Members of a group are granted the group's tenant role on any tenant whose tags are a subset of the group's tags.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    hatchet = {
      source  = "hatchet-dev/hatchet"
      version = "~> 0.2.1"
    }
  }
}

provider "hatchet" {
  # Token is read from HATCHET_CLOUD_MANAGEMENT_TOKEN environment variable
}

# Members of this group are granted the ADMIN role on any tenant tagged "platform"
resource "hatchet_user_group" "platform_admins" {
  name = "platform-admins"
  role = "ADMIN"
  tags = ["platform"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the user group.
- `role` (String) The tenant role granted to group members when synced to a matching tenant. One of `OWNER`, `ADMIN`, `MEMBER`.

### Optional

- `tags` (List of String) Tags that determine which tenants this group's members are synced to.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the user group.
- `member_count` (Number) The number of organization members in this group.
